{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Yoga pants, wide-leg silhouette, mid-calf length, charcoal gray (#36454F), moisture-wicking technical knit with a slight compression fit.
Running jacket, relaxed boxy cut, hip-length hem, deep forest green (#2E4D39), softshell nylon with subtle brushed interior for warmth.
Minimalist leather sneakers, low-profile design, off-white shade (#FAFAFA), smooth full-grain leather upper with flexible rubber sole.

This outfit works because it perfectly balances the physical demands of an early morning yoga session with the cozy yet polished aesthetic desired for autumn daylight. The technical fabric ensures you stay warm without overheating during practice, while the wide-leg cut allows for unrestricted movement and a flattering drape over the body's lines. Completing the look with dark forest green adds depth to the neutral base, creating a refined sporty vibe that respects your refusal of reading-heavy attire by keeping everything practical and visually light."}
